description: A Dart source file defining common reusable UI widgets for a Flutter application, including buttons, card headers, loading, empty, and error states, as well as a snack bar utility and a mock mode helper.

classes.name: PrimaryButton
classes.description: A themed primary button widget with icon support and busy state indication.

classes.name: SecondaryButton
classes.description: A themed secondary outline button with icon support.

classes.name: GradientHeaderCard
classes.description: A card component with a gradient header, optional leading icon, title, subtitle, and content.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: A widget displaying a loading spinner and message, used as a placeholder for loading states.

classes.name: EmptyState
classes.description: A placeholder widget indicating no data with an icon, title, and message.

classes.name: ErrorState
classes.description: A widget displaying an error message with an optional retry button.

methods.name: showAppSnackBar
methods.description: Displays a themed SnackBar with an optional action.

methods.name: isMockMode
methods.description: Helps determine if the app is running in mock mode based on environment settings.
